info.name: N3XT API Documentation Approvals Payments API

items.docs:
Allows the authenticated user to create an instant payment to a business.
Optionally provide recipientWalletAddress to send to a specific wallet of that business (address must belong to the business).

params.name: direction
params.description: Filter requests by direction ('incoming' for requests to you, 'outgoing' for requests from you).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of payment requests to return (optional).

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for pagination (optional).

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the payment requests to filter (optional).

items.docs: Get a list of payment requests filtered by direction (incoming or outgoing).
Allows the authenticated user to request a payment from another business.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the payment request to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieve a specific payment request by its ID.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the payment request to update.

items.docs: Update the status of a payment request.

params.name: status
params.description: Comma-separated list of payment statuses to filter by. Available statuses: queued, requested, initiated, lockbox, released, partial, cancelled, declined, completed, failed. Example: "completed,lockbox" (optional).

params.name: walletId
params.description: Filter payments by specific wallet ID. Must be a valid UUID format (optional).

params.name: startDate
params.description: Filter payments created after this date (ISO 8601 format) (optional).

params.name: endDate
params.description: Filter payments created before this date (ISO 8601 format) (optional).

params.name: amountGreaterThan
params.description: Filter payments with transaction amount greater than or equal to this value (optional).

params.name: amountLessThan
params.description: Filter payments with transaction amount less than or equal to this value (optional).

params.name: senderBusinessId
params.description: Filter payments with sender business ID (optional).

params.name: recipientBusinessId
params.description: Filter payments with recipient business ID (optional).

params.name: businessId
params.description: Filter payments where sender or recipient matches business ID (optional).. This is a legacy filter that is no longer supported.

params.name: description
params.description: Filter payments by description (case-insensitive partial match) (optional).

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sort payments by a field. Available fields: createdAt, updatedAt. (optional).

params.name: order
params.description: Sort direction. Available values: asc, desc. Example: "asc" (optional).

params.name: limit
params.description: the maximum number of payments returned. Default: 100. Max: 200.(optional).

params.name: offset
params.description: page offset to start from (based on the limit). Default: 0.(optional).

items.docs: Retrieve a list of all payments made by the authenticated user.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the payment to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieve the details of a specific payment by its ID.
